<script>
(() => {
  let dotNav = document.querySelector('.ds-dot-nav');
  function alignNav() {
    if (!dotNav) return;
    let btn = document.querySelector('.nav-cta');
    if (btn) {
      let right = window.innerWidth - btn.getBoundingClientRect().right;
      dotNav.style.right = Math.max(8, right) + 'px';
    }
  }
  alignNav();
  window.addEventListener('resize', alignNav);

  let navItems = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ds-dot-nav-item'));
  let sections = navItems.map((item) => {
    return document.getElementById(item.dataset.target);
  }).filter(Boolean);
  let currentIndex = 0;

  function navbarHeight() {
    let nav = document.querySelector('.navbar, .quarto-navbar, header.navbar');
    return nav ? nav.offsetHeight + 12 : 80;
  }

  function setActive(index) {
    currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, sections.length - 1));
    navItems.forEach((item, i) => {
      item.classList.toggle('is-active', i === currentIndex);
    });
  }

  function goTo(index) {
    index = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, sections.length - 1));
    setActive(index);
    let top = sections[index].getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - navbarHeight();
    window.scrollTo({ top: top, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  navItems.forEach((item, i) => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => { goTo(i); });
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); goTo(currentIndex + 1); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp')   { e.preventDefault(); goTo(currentIndex - 1); }
  });

  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    let observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          let idx = sections.indexOf(entry.target);
          if (idx !== -1) setActive(idx);
        }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: '-35% 0px -35% 0px', threshold: 0 });
    sections.forEach((s) => { observer.observe(s); });
  }

  setActive(0);
})();
</script>
